notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
We felt that some part of the game were too punishing, so we felt that we had to make some changes in the level. We also removed Fun Mode for now, as we didn't feel that it provided any values for our players.

The changes:

- Made some places less punishable in the game, as we figured it was too discouraging.
- Made some places easier early game, as we've noticed a big portion of players tend to be stuck there
- Removed "Fun Mode"
- Leaderboard now shows up to 5000 at a time instead of top 10.

With these changes, we hope that those who were stuck early in the game are less discouraged and gets to progress further into the game, and that places where you fall down is JUST painful enough without making our players insta alt+f4.

notes.title: Updates for UpWakeNing
notes.notes:
We've made some updates on known bugs for UpWakeNing.

First, we've implemented that when you're in Options, you can now press the key "Esc" to go back to the game. 

Second we have fixed the following:

- When you've reached the goal, the credits will now go to the end screen automatically after it has finished rolling.

- The game will no longer freeze/be paused when you play Lucid Dreaming Mode, quit and then go to either Normal Mode or Lucid Dreaming Mode again.
